steps.path: While the assistant is writing the plan
steps.headline: The card is one line while the plan is being written, like every other collapsed card in the chat.
steps.changed: The clock and the wait note moved up into the card's own line: 'Plan: … writing the plan · 1m 12s · can take a few minutes on your computer'. The second line under it is gone. The note about waiting only appears on a model running on your computer.
steps.notice: A plan being written takes exactly as much room as any other card until it has something to show.
steps.risk: On a very narrow window the line is cut with an ellipsis rather than wrapping.

steps.path: A plan that is running, with one specialist opened
steps.headline: Each specialist is your existing specialist card again: open it for its brief, its thinking and tool calls, and its report.
steps.changed: The plain name-and-status lines are gone. Every specialist inside a step is now the same card you already get when your assistant hires one: a collapsed row that opens onto Briefing, Activity and Report, with Send-a-note and Stop while it works. The nesting reads plan, then step, then specialist. Stop the plan is red-outlined at the bottom right.
steps.notice: You can watch any one specialist in the plan as closely as you watch a specialist hired on its own, without leaving the plan card.
steps.risk: With several specialists open at once the plan card gets tall; each one starts closed, and a finished step folds.

steps.path: A plan paused at its limit
steps.headline: The paused card drops the reassurance sentence, and Stop sits red on the left of Add budget at the bottom right.
steps.changed: The line now reads only 'Paused — step 1 hit its 27,000-token limit with 2 of 3 reviewers done.' The buttons moved from the bottom left to the bottom right, Stop in the app's red outline, to the left of Add budget.
steps.notice: Less to read, and the safe button is never the one your thumb lands on by habit.
steps.risk: The limit line above still says what was spent against what, so the promise is not lost, just shorter.

steps.headline: The amount stays on the left and the two buttons sit together at the bottom right, Cancel before Continue.
steps.changed: Same row as before, re-ordered: the field and its dollar figure hold the left, Cancel then Continue sit at the right edge.
steps.notice: The button that spends money is the furthest right, where the plan's other forward buttons are.
steps.risk: None visible; the suggested amount is still the paused step's own limit.

steps.headline: Stop, in red, sits to the left of Continue at the bottom right.
steps.changed: The two buttons moved from the bottom left to the bottom right and swapped order, so Continue is the rightmost on this card and on the paused one.
steps.notice: Both cards that can restart work now put their buttons in the same place, in the same order.
